items.title: Write the 3x2 review escalation execution plan
items.context: Document trigger semantics, host independence proof, gate placement, artifacts, code touchpoints, tests, rollout, and acceptance criteria. The plan must specify that normal stories start with the existing REVIEW flow, then escalate to three rounds by two independent hosts when the first REVIEW round records two or more verified findings. Decision-doc changes remain always-on 3x2.
items.userSees: User sees: Wrote docs/requirements/decisions/three-round-two-host-review-escalation-execution-plan.md and verified it documents the >=2 first-round verified findings trigger, the always-on decision-doc 3x2 rule, true host/session/key independence, implementation touchpoints, tests, and rollout steps.

happy.desc: The execution plan exists in docs/requirements/decisions/ and clearly states the normal default REVIEW path plus automatic 3x2 escalation when the first REVIEW round records two or more verified findings.
The plan preserves the existing always-on 3x2 DONE gate for direct decision-doc changes regardless of finding count.

edge.desc: The plan identifies hostId-only counting as insufficient and requires durable host, provider, session, key, signature, and material binding for counted 3x2 verdicts.
The plan requires verdicts to become stale when final HEAD, material digest, or validation digest changes.

adversarial.desc: The plan requires negative controls proving same-session, same-key, duplicate-host, stale-digest, FAIL, BLOCKED, suspected, and disproven evidence cannot satisfy 3x2.
The plan requires process fact registry and lifecycle gate enforcement, so AGENTS, prompt, or prose-only changes cannot count as implementation.
